gloss: wealth gap; gap between rich and poor

definitions.gloss: wealth gap; disparity between rich and poor
definitions.explanation: The difference in economic status between wealthy and poor members of a society.

examples.japanese: {貧富|ひんぷ}の{差|さ}が{広|ひろ}がっている。
{教育|きょういく}が{貧富|ひんぷ}の{差|さ}を{縮|ちぢ}める{鍵|かぎ}になる。
examples.english: Education is the key to narrowing the wealth gap.

examples.japanese: {貧富|ひんぷ}の{差|さ}が{激|はげ}しい{国|くに}では、{社会的|しゃかいてき}な{不安定|ふあんてい}さが{増|ま}す{傾向|けいこう}がある。
examples.english: In countries with severe wealth gaps, social instability tends to increase.

notes:
{貧富|ひんぷ} (poverty and wealth) + の (possessive) + {差|さ} (difference, gap). A set phrase used in news, politics, and social commentary to discuss economic inequality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貧富|ひんぷ}の{差|さ}が{広|ひろ}がる — the wealth gap widens
- {貧富|ひんぷ}の{差|さ}を{縮|ちぢ}める — narrow the wealth gap
- {貧富|ひんぷ}の{差|さ}が{激|はげ}しい — the wealth gap is severe
- {貧富|ひんぷ}の{差|さ}をなくす — eliminate the wealth gap

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {格差|かくさ} — disparity; gap — broader term covering any kind of gap (income, education, regional)
- {経済格差|けいざいかくさ} — economic disparity — more formal and precise
- {所得格差|しょとくかくさ} — income gap — focuses specifically on income rather than overall wealth
